list_domains.name: list_domains
list_domains.description: Retrieve a list of all domains in your account.

per_page.description: Number of domains to return per page (1-200).

page.description: Which page of results to return.

aiMetadata.description: Lists all DNS domains managed under the authenticated DigitalOcean account, paginated. Use to discover available domains or look one up by name before acting on it. Read-only and idempotent; supports per-page and page controls.

create_domain.name: create_domain
create_domain.description: Add a new domain to your DigitalOcean account.

ip_address.description: Optional IP address to create an A record pointing to the apex domain.

aiMetadata.description: Registers a new DNS domain on the authenticated DigitalOcean account; optionally creates an apex A record when an IP address is supplied. Use when onboarding a domain to DigitalOcean DNS. Not idempotent — re-running with an existing domain name fails, and each successful call mutates account state.

get_domain.name: get_domain
get_domain.description: Retrieve details about a specific domain.

domain_name.description: The domain name to retrieve (e.g., example.com).

aiMetadata.description: Fetches details for a single DNS domain on the DigitalOcean account, identified by its exact domain name. Use when you already know the domain name and need its TTL or zone file. Read-only and idempotent.

delete_domain.name: delete_domain
delete_domain.description: Remove a domain from your DigitalOcean account.

domain_name.description: The domain name to delete (e.g., example.com).

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a DNS domain (and its records) from the DigitalOcean account, identified by exact domain name. Use to tear down DNS for a domain you no longer manage. Destructive; effectively idempotent on the end state but the first call removes the domain and later calls on a missing domain fail.

list_droplets.name: list_droplets
list_droplets.description: Retrieve a list of all Droplets in your account.

per_page.description: Number of Droplets to return per page (1-200).

page.description: Which page of results to return.

tag_name.description: Filter Droplets by a specific tag. Cannot be combined with Name or Type.

name.description: Filter by exact Droplet name (case-insensitive). Cannot be combined with Tag Name.

type.description: Filter by Droplet type. Cannot be combined with Tag Name.

aiMetadata.description: Lists Droplets (virtual machines) on the authenticated DigitalOcean account, paginated. Returns all Droplets by default, or filters to a single tag, an exact name, or a Droplet type (standard vs. GPU); tag filtering cannot be combined with name or type. Use to discover Droplets or resolve a Droplet id before acting on it. Read-only and idempotent.

get_droplet.name: get_droplet
get_droplet.description: Retrieve details about a specific Droplet.

auth.description: Connect your DigitalOcean account using OAuth2.
Generate a Personal Access Token from DigitalOcean Control Panel under API > Personal access tokens.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches full details (status, region, size, networks, tags) for a single Droplet on the DigitalOcean account, identified by its numeric Droplet id. Use when you have a Droplet id and need its current state. Read-only and idempotent.

create_droplet.name: create_droplet
create_droplet.description: Create a new Droplet or multiple Droplets.

creation_mode.description: Create a single Droplet or multiple Droplets at once.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the event log (configuration changes, maintenance, scaling) for one managed database cluster on the DigitalOcean account, identified by its cluster UUID. Use to audit or inspect recent activity on a specific cluster. Read-only and idempotent.
